statement.excerpt: there is no obvious moat, Meta is giving away similar software for free

from_speaker: Meta is giving away similar software for free
our_interpretation: A moat means a clear, durable competitive advantage that competitors cannot readily overcome. A temporary lead on a benchmark is insufficient.
Similar software means general-purpose language models with comparable uses and capabilities, not identical products or performance.
Free means no license fee for ordinary permitted use. It does not imply free computing resources or unrestricted licensing.
For this ongoing observation, use the latest publicly observable state during September 1–25, 2024, ending at publication.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes both a comparable, no-fee Meta offering and the absence of a clear, durable OpenAI competitive advantage.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes a clear, durable OpenAI competitive advantage, or establishes that Meta offered no comparable software without a license fee.
